[LCRS.6.3.3] No call in this edition honours `retain:`: the hydration calls
that take it are deferred ([LHYD.6.2]). The validator must reject it on every
call with `DS_VALIDATE_RETAIN_UNWIRED` — a specific loud code rather than the
generic unknown-kwarg `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_KWARG`, and never a silent skip,
because `retain` is a reserved modifier name.

Response-fact lifetime is governed by superseding-call
retraction ([LCRS.6.2]) and by the schema's TTL ([LCRS.6.6]).
